verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs describe real-time, scoped access to customer systems via short-lived JWT tokens, integrations that 'retrieve data, take action' across chat/email/voice, MCP-based tool connectivity, and Browser Actions for systems lacking a traditional integration — all framed as enabling agents to act on live account/order data rather than static help content. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that responses actually surface specific plan/order/account details, and a concrete case study showing this in production.
